issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect PersonService::addParent(Person, Person) to be a public method that students implement and which is invoked from the REST layer and tests. In the solution, addParent is declared private, while PersonResource and the unit tests call personService.addParent(...). This visibility change is inconsistent and would prevent the REST controller and tests from calling the method (compilation/runtime mismatch), causing confusion about the intended API surface of PersonService.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the addParent(Person, Person) method public in PersonService so its visibility matches the template, the problem description, and the tests/REST controller. Alternatively, if the intent was to keep it non-public, update PersonResource and tests to call the appropriate public facade method. The simplest fix preserving the educational intent is to change 'private Person addParent(...)' to 'public Person addParent(...)' in src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/service/PersonService.java.
